text: The 2022 loss of about 0.6 hectares (3.4% of the asset) in native forest on the 17.6-hectare rural property was confirmed by satellite data, but the specific cause remains unclear. The change could have been due to harvesting, fire, storms, or other disturbances—it was not necessarily illegal deforestation or land-use conversion. The evidence shows that the area was native forest, but it does not identify responsible parties, legality, or compliance with regulations like the EU Deforestation Regulation. Further investigation would be needed to determine the exact cause or whether the activity was authorized.
